20261121-physics-m3-1.material: Roller coaster ine huremu hwe2 kg inotanga ichimira pakukwirira kwemamita 20 panzira isina friction. Kinetic energy yayo panguva inosvika pasi ndeyei? (g = 9.8 m/s²)
20261121-physics-m3-1.thinking.0: Roller coaster ine huremu hwe2 kg
20261121-physics-m3-1.s.s1.prompt: Roller coaster ine huremu hwe2 kg inotanga ichimira pakukwirira kwemamita 20 panzira isina friction. Kinetic energy yayo panguva inosvika pasi ndeyei? (g = 9.8 m/s²)
20261121-physics-m3-1.s.s1.explain: Mutemo wokuchengetedzwa kwemechanical energy unoita kuti potential energy yakaderera ive kinetic energy yose. $E_k = mgh = 2\text{ kg} \times 9.8\text{ m/s}^2 \times 20\text{ m} = 392\text{ J}$.

20261121-physics-m3-2.title: Kana kumhanya kwemotokari mugwagwa kukawedzera kaviri
20261121-physics-m3-2.topic: Kana kumhanya kwemotokari mugwagwa kukawedzera kaviri
20261121-physics-m3-2.goal: Apply principles of Kana kumhanya kwemotokari mugwagwa kukawedzera kaviri to solve the reasoning problem.
20261121-physics-m3-2.material: Kana kumhanya kwemotokari mugwagwa kukawedzera kaviri kubva pa50 km/h kusvika pa100 km/h, chinhambwe chokumisa panguva yokukwidza breki chinowedzera nokuwanda kwakadini mu theory?
20261121-physics-m3-2.thinking.0: Kana kumhanya kwemotokari mugwagwa kukawedzera kaviri
20261121-physics-m3-2.s.s1.prompt: Kana kumhanya kwemotokari mugwagwa kukawedzera kaviri kubva pa50 km/h kusvika pa100 km/h, chinhambwe chokumisa panguva yokukwidza breki chinowedzera nokuwanda kwakadini mu theory?
20261121-physics-m3-2.s.s1.explain: Basa rinoitwa nesimba refriction panguva yechinhambwe chokumisa $s$ rinotora kinetic energy, saka $f \cdot s = \frac{1}{2}mv^2 \implies s \propto v^2$. Kumhanya kukawedzera $2$ kaviri, chinhambwe chokumisa chinokwira nokukurumidza kusvika $2^2 = 4$ kaviri.

20261122-physics-m3-2.s.s1.explain: Kumhanya kwokudonha kukawedzera, simba rokuramba kwemhepo rinokwira kumusoro rinowedzera uye rinoenzana negravity inokwidza pasi, net force inova 0 uye kukurumidza kunomira, saka chinodonha nokumhanya kwakaenzana (terminal velocity).

20261119-physics-h1.title: Mazai maviri ehuremu hwakaenzana akadonhiswa kubva
20261119-physics-h1.topic: Mazai maviri ehuremu hwakaenzana akadonhiswa kubva
20261119-physics-h1.goal: Apply principles of Mazai maviri ehuremu hwakaenzana akadonhiswa kubva to solve the reasoning problem.
20261119-physics-h1.material: Mazai maviri ehuremu hwakaenzana akadonhiswa kubva pakukwirira kumwe chete, rimwe pasimende uye rimwe pamusoro pegaba rakapfava. Kubva pandimomwe raibata pasi kusvika raimira, ndeipi kuenzanisa chaiko kwemaquantity efizikisi?
20261119-physics-h1.thinking.0: Mazai maviri ehuremu hwakaenzana akadonhiswa kubva
20261119-physics-h1.s.s1.prompt: Mazai maviri ehuremu hwakaenzana akadonhiswa kubva pakukwirira kumwe chete, rimwe pasimende uye rimwe pamusoro pegaba rakapfava. Kubva pandimomwe raibata pasi kusvika raimira, ndeipi kuenzanisa chaiko kwemaquantity efizikisi?
20261119-physics-h1.s.s1.explain: Momentum change ($\Delta p$) yemazai maviri yakaenzana, saka impulse ($I = F\Delta t$) yakaenzana. Gaba rinowedzera nguva yokurova $\Delta t$, richideredza simba pakati rokurova $F = \frac{I}{\Delta t}$, saka izai harikuputike.
20261119-physics-h1.s.s1.hint.0: Sezvo akadonha kubva pakukwirira kumwe chete, kumhanya risati rarova nokushanduka kwemomentum (momentum change = impulse) kwakaenzana.
20261119-physics-h1.s.s1.hint.1: Gaba rakapfava rinopfava richiwedzera nguva yokurova (Δt).
20261119-physics-h1.s.s1.o.o0: Huwandu hweimpulse inogamuchirwa hwakaenzana, asi simba pakati rinogamuchirwa neizai riri pagaba ririduku

20261121-physics-h1-1.title: Bhora rebaseball rine huremu hwe0
20261121-physics-h1-1.goal: Apply principles of Bhora rebaseball rine huremu hwe0 to solve the reasoning problem.
20261121-physics-h1-1.material: Bhora rebaseball rine huremu hwe0.5 kg rinouya nokumhanya kwe30 m/s uye rakarohwa nebat, rikadzoka nenzira yakatarisana nokumhanya kwe40 m/s. Huwandu hweimpulse yakagamuchirwa nebhora ndeupi?
20261121-physics-h1-1.s.s1.prompt: Bhora rebaseball rine huremu hwe0.5 kg rinouya nokumhanya kwe30 m/s uye rakarohwa nebat, rikadzoka nenzira yakatarisana nokumhanya kwe40 m/s. Huwandu hweimpulse yakagamuchirwa nebhora ndeupi?
20261121-physics-h1-1.s.s1.explain: Momentum yepakutanga ndi $p_1 = 0.5 \times 30 = +15\text{ kg}\cdot\text{m/s}$, yepakupedzisira ndi $p_2 = 0.5 \times (-40) = -20\text{ kg}\cdot\text{m/s}$. Huwandu hweimpulse ndi $|\Delta p| = |-20 - 15| = 35\text{ N}\cdot\text{s}$.
20261121-physics-h1-1.s.s1.hint.1: Rangarira zviratidzo sezvo rakadzoka nenzira yakatarisana! (v_pakutanga = +30, v_pakupedzisira = -40)

20261121-physics-h1-2.title: Chinhu chitsva chinopedza electrical resistance zvachose
20261121-physics-h1-2.topic: Chinhu chitsva chinopedza electrical resistance zvachose
20261121-physics-h1-2.goal: Apply principles of Chinhu chitsva chinopedza electrical resistance zvachose to solve the reasoning problem.
20261121-physics-h1-2.material: Chinhu chitsva chinopedza electrical resistance zvachose kana chakadzikiswa pasi pe 'critical temperature' uye chinoratidza 'Meissner effect' yokusundira magnetic field kunze ndechipi?
20261121-physics-h1-2.thinking.0: Chinhu chitsva chinopedza electrical resistance zvachose
20261121-physics-h1-2.s.s1.prompt: Chinhu chitsva chinopedza electrical resistance zvachose kana chakadzikiswa pasi pe 'critical temperature' uye chinoratidza 'Meissner effect' yokusundira magnetic field kunze ndechipi?
20261121-physics-h1-2.s.s1.explain: Superconductor pasi pe critical temperature inoratidza superconductivity iri nokuda kwokuti electrical resistance inova $0$ uye Meissner effect inosundira kunze magnetic field yokunze zvachose (perfect diamagnetism).
20261121-physics-h1-2.s.s1.hint.0: Zvinhu zvenguva yemberi zvinoshandiswa mutrain ye maglev kana muchiridzwa cheMRI.

20261122-physics-h1-1.title: Chinhu chine huremu hwe1 kg chakakandwa
20261122-physics-h1-1.topic: Chinhu chine huremu hwe1 kg chakakandwa
20261122-physics-h1-1.goal: Apply principles of Chinhu chine huremu hwe1 kg chakakandwa to solve the reasoning problem.
20261122-physics-h1-1.material: [Mechanics yepamusoro] Chinhu chine huremu hwe1 kg chakakandwa nenzira yakachinjika nokumhanya kwe20 m/s kubva paruzivo rwegomo rinokwirira mamita 80. Chinhambwe chakachinjika chakafambwa kusvika chasvika pasi ndechei? (g = 10 m/s², usatarise kuramba kwemhepo)
20261122-physics-h1-1.thinking.0: Chinhu chine huremu hwe1 kg chakakandwa
20261122-physics-h1-1.s.s1.prompt: [Mechanics yepamusoro] Chinhu chine huremu hwe1 kg chakakandwa nenzira yakachinjika nokumhanya kwe20 m/s kubva paruzivo rwegomo rinokwirira mamita 80. Chinhambwe chakachinjika chakafambwa kusvika chasvika pasi ndechei? (g = 10 m/s², usatarise kuramba kwemhepo)
20261122-physics-h1-1.s.s1.explain: Nguva yokudonha yakatwasuka ndi $80 = \frac{1}{2} \times 10 \times t^2 \implies t^2 = 16 \implies t = 4$ masekondi. Chinhambwe chakachinjika, sezvo kufamba kwakaenzana, ndi $x = v_x t = 20\text{ m/s} \times 4\text{ s} = 80\text{ m}$.
20261122-physics-h1-1.s.s1.hint.0: Tanga wawana nguva yokudonha t: h = (1/2) g t² → 80 = (1/2) × 10 × t²
20261122-physics-h1-1.s.s1.hint.1: Verenga chinhambwe chakachinjika x = v_x × t.

20261122-physics-h1-2.title: Ndechipi chikonzero chesainzi chinoita kuti OLED
20261122-physics-h1-2.topic: Ndechipi chikonzero chesainzi chinoita kuti OLED
20261122-physics-h1-2.goal: Apply principles of Ndechipi chikonzero chesainzi chinoita kuti OLED to solve the reasoning problem.
20261122-physics-h1-2.material: Ndechipi chikonzero chesainzi chinoita kuti OLED (organic light-emitting diode) inoshandiswa mumafoni nemateleviziyoni itete uye ive nemusiyano wakanaka wokupenya kupfuura LCD yakare?
20261122-physics-h1-2.thinking.0: Ndechipi chikonzero chesainzi chinoita kuti OLED
20261122-physics-h1-2.s.s1.prompt: Ndechipi chikonzero chesainzi chinoita kuti OLED (organic light-emitting diode) inoshandiswa mumafoni nemateleviziyoni itete uye ive nemusiyano wakanaka wokupenya kupfuura LCD yakare?
20261122-physics-h1-2.s.s1.explain: OLED inoshandisa organic semiconductor thin film inoyedza chiedza kana magetsi ayerera, saka haidi backlight yakakora, uye nokudzima pixel kunowanikwa mutema wakakwana ine contrast ratio isingaperi.
20261122-physics-h1-2.s.s1.hint.0: LCD inofanira backlight inopa chiedza kubva kumashure.
20261122-physics-h1-2.s.s1.hint.1: Pixel imwe neimwe yeOLED inoyedza yoga (self-emissive).
20261122-physics-h1-2.s.s1.o.o0: Nokuti inoshandisa zvidimbu zvearganic compound zvinoyedza zvoga nokuda kwokusakwana backlight yakaparadzana
20261122-physics-h1-2.s.s1.o.o1: Nokuti OLED mvura isingashandise magetsi zvachose
20261122-physics-h1-2.s.s1.o.o2: Nokuti mukati meOLED mune ma fluorescent lamp madiki zviuru
20261122-physics-h1-2.s.s1.o.o3: Nokuti inoshandisa mapuranga esimbi panzvimbo yegirazi
